label: S5 sense: a CONTINGENT_1 actual being excludes possible collapse, by the T and 5 schemas and S5 law
meaning: S5 reading of NECESSARY_2. The OPEN T and 5 schemas give a reflexive Euclidean (S5) frame by the T and 5 correspondences; by the verified S5 law (MODAL-S5-LAWS) possible collapse at w leaves no proposition contingent at w (possibly true and possibly false). The existence of the node's witness is such a proposition: true at w, which w accesses, and false at the accessible world lacking it. Without the 5 schema the rival, the node and the T schema hold together (false-le-true frame); without the node the rival holds. Reconciled interface: closed modal laws and correspondence certificates are imported and applied as verified theorems, not retained as assumptions; only the displayed node and frame schemas remain premises. The schema premise explicitly uses the modal fixture frame (NECESSARY_11) of the same Ontic whose individual box-existence is NECESSARY_2; this is the registered frame-to-individual semantic bridge, not an equivalence with a different metaphysical necessity.
